annotations.text:
Community tab — three directions, all built on the app's real tokens read from index.html: Rubik 400–800, ground #152342, surface #1F3057, brass #E8B98A, energy #E85D3D, 20px card radius, chips 9×16px at radius 12.

Added as a display face: Secular One, a Hebrew geometric display, used only for headline moments against Rubik for everything else.

Leftmost is the baseline — what ships today at 4.8.0 — after the one-rail change and the Hebrew display face, both now live.

A · HEIGHT FIRST — one dominant block answers "what is the box doing today, who's in, what do I tap" at a glance. The feed becomes a compact digest below it.

Tradeoff: strongest for a member checking in before class. Its weakness — a rest day with nothing to say — is answered on the מסכים page.

B · QUIET — no cards for chrome. Text tabs instead of chip buttons, hairline rules instead of borders, posts given room. Today is one line with one action, not a hero.

Tradeoff: the calmest and most readable, and closest to a feed people already know. Today's programming is easy to scroll past — the opposite of A's bet.

C · THE WALL — the box's physical whiteboard as the surface. Slate with chalk dust, names in a plain row with no figures and no order that could read as rank.

Tradeoff: the most memorable and most opinionated. It introduces a texture the rest of the app doesn't have, so it either spreads or sits alone.

THE BOARD — where the privacy rule becomes visible. נועה is listed by name with "מוסתרת" where a figure would be, not a blank a member would read as a bug.

Order is attach order. The rule is stated once at the bottom, explaining what was just seen rather than pre-empting it, with a link to the member's own settings and no nudge to change them.

REST DAY — the honest answer to A's weakness. With no programming, the hero does not render an empty shell: it collapses to one line, and the feed takes the space back.

This is the same "renders nothing when empty" rule the app already follows — and the reason the onboarding skeleton was removed in 4.7.2.
